import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1;
        // Actually there is only one test case, but loop for consistency
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            int P = sc.nextInt();
            int K = sc.nextInt();
            int[] k = new int[P];
            for (int x = 0; x < P; x++) {
                k[x] = (K * x) % P;
            }

            if (K == 0) {
                System.out.println(modPow(P, P - 1, MOD));
                continue;
            }

            int[] f = new int[P];
            int[] c = new int[P];
            long ans = 1;

            for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
                if (f[i] != 0) continue;
                int cnt = 1;
                int u = i;
                f[u] = 1;
                while (f[k[u]] == 0) {
                    u = k[u];
                    f[u] = 1;
                    cnt++;
                }
                c[cnt]++;
            }

            for (int i = 1; i < P; i++) {
                if (c[i] != 0) {
                    long cnt = (long) i * c[i] + (i > 1 ? 1 : 0);
                    ans = (ans * modPow(cnt, c[i], MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }

            System.out.println(ans);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
